comparisons.peer_summary: From time to time, the Company may sell or license portions of its intellectual property portfolio.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose policies regarding the licensing or selling of intellectual property, but they apply to different scopes of their business. AVGO's disclosure focuses on its Infrastructure Software segment, offering software solutions and mission-critical FC SAN products to simplify IT environments. AMD's disclosure is a general statement about selling or licensing portions of its IP portfolio without specifying a particular product line or segment. While both involve IP monetization, AVGO details specific software capabilities (mainframe, cloud, edge) while AMD provides only a generic strategic option.

sentences.text: We provide a portfolio of software solutions that help enterprises simplify their IT environments so they can increase business velocity and flexibility, and enable customers to plan, develop, deliver, automate, manage and secure applications across mainframe, distributed, edge, mobile, and private and hybrid cloud platforms.
From time to time, the Company may also sell or license portions of its IP portfolio.

comparisons.peer_topic: Implementation of Internal Foundry Operating Model
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel implemented an internal foundry operating model in Q1 2024, creating a foundry relationship between Intel Products (CCG, DCAI, NEX) and Intel Foundry, which involves CPU design/development and manufacturing/services respectively.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures describe fundamental structural changes to how the companies organize and report their business segments in 2024. AVGO defines its Infrastructure Software segment, which includes software for hybrid clouds and mission-critical SAN products. INTC describes the implementation of an internal foundry operating model that creates a specific relationship between its Intel Products (CCG, DCAI, NEX) and Intel Foundry businesses. While AVGO defines a software-centric segment, INTC defines a hardware/manufacturing operational model, but both are segment reporting definitions within Item 8.

sentences.text: Our portfolio of infrastructure and security software is designed to modernize, optimize, and secure the most complex private and hybrid cloud environments, enabling scalability, agility, automation, insights, resiliency and security making it easy for customers to run their mission-critical workloads.

We previously announced the implementation of our internal foundry operating model, which took effect in the first quarter of 2024, and creates a foundry relationship between our Intel Products business (collectively CCG, DCAI, and NEX) and our Intel Foundry business.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Mobile Business Unit includes memory and storage products sold into the smartphone and other mobile-device markets.

MU identifies a Mobile Business Unit (MBU) focused on memory and storage products for smartphones and mobile devices.
